platform: Raspberry Pi CM4, 8 GB, 4 x Cortex-A72 at 1.5 GHz, running Linux
runtime: llama.cpp (a public fork with packed ternary support), release build, 4 threads, context 512, HTTP server timings
model: the third-party 27B ternary base model that Attis is adapted from, as a packed 2-bit GGUF file (7.17 GB)
environment: no swap thrashing; model resident in RAM after loading; 45.2 C, not throttled, all cores at 1.5 GHz
note: a reference point for the bare-metal firmware on the same board; not a matched experiment (different dates, builds and run lengths; Attis adds post-trained components to the base model)
